Taiwan warns Canada on risks of deeper China ties

Taiwan has cautioned Canada that deepening its relationship with China carries inherent risks. This warning was conveyed to Canada's Mark Carney, with Taiwan highlighting potential dangers associated with closer ties to Beijing. The context involves ongoing geopolitical dynamics between China, the United States, and other nations in the Asia-Pacific region, including Japan's recent APEC summit interactions with China and expert analyses of future China-US relations.
